sources.title: elrashid/sae-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-topk-l16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A TopK sparse autoencoder for meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, residual-stream layer 16 (d_in=4096, d_sae=65536, k=64, FVU=0.3371). Trained with the v2 recipe (BOS-drop + per-dim standardization) for The Refusal Slope: A Mechanistic Taxonomy of Feature Fate in Quantized Edge Intelligence (M. Elrashid, BUiD).

sources.title: elrashid/gate-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-l16 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A SAE safety gate for meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct: logistic regression over sparse-autoencoder features of the layer-16 residual stream, scoring P (harmful) from the prompt before generation starts.
